ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across central lobes vs 20% low-intensity (black) pixels along perimeters and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black border along leading and trailing edges; large irregular black cluster at the insertion of the right lobe; multiple small, dark punctate spots scattered across both high-intensity central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch, approximately 50 degrees, with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, irregular serrations with peak-to-valley amplitudes of 3-5 pixels; left lobe trailing edge is smoother with low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe follows a predominantly convex sweep; left lobe follows a more linear, diagonal trajectory towards the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the medial high-intensity regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel, dark linear streaks oriented diagonally on the lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged edge irregularities on the right lobe trailing edge consistent with physical trauma; distinct parallel rake-like linear marks on the right lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, asymmetrical dark pigmentation field at the junction of the right fluke lobe and the peduncle.
